primitives.note: Umbra Blades empowers next basic attack every 12s (reduced by attacks) for 120% AD physical damage to primary target plus proc damage to nearby enemies, with a self-heal
basic attacks reduce Umbra Blades' cooldown by 1s (3s vs champions/monsters)
Umbra Blades' primary-target hit can crit, changing its coefficient to 110% AD x total crit damage
Duskbringer deals base+85% bonus AD physical damage on a short delay/travel, on cooldown
Q's Dusk Trail grants bonus AD and move speed for 5s while standing on it; W passively grants bonus AS, doubled for 5s after blocking with the active shield
Shroud of Darkness spell shield block itself is a defensive proc irrelevant to the damage-only dummy fight, though its AS payoff is not
Unspeakable Horror ticks magic damage every 0.5s over a 2s tether
Paranoia is cast then recast as a dash that deals physical damage on arrival; cooldown starts only after recast/timeout
mana costs on all four abilities may gate casts across the 15s fight depending on mana pool/regen

needsBespoke.why: All damage-relevant mechanics (empowered on-hit passive with crit and cooldown refund, plain-cast projectile with a separate self-buff, DoT tether, recast dash) map onto existing primitives.

unsettled.question: What is Umbra Blades' passive base cooldown-trigger interval within the 15s fight (i.e., does it fire purely off the 12s internal cooldown reduced by on-hit CDR, or is there a minimum attack-count gate)?
options: Fires every 12s minus AA-CDR reductions (effectively can fire much faster than 12s given repeated attacks)
Fires on a fixed 12s timer regardless of attacks, with CDR only mattering between activations
quotes: Basic attacks reduce ''Umbra Blades' '' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second, increased to 3 against enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.

unsettled.question: Does Umbra Blades' primary-target damage replace the normal basic attack damage on that swing, or is it added on top of the normal basic attack?
options: Umbra Blades replaces/enhances that single basic attack (attack damage becomes 120% AD instead of 100% AD)
Umbra Blades damage is separate bonus damage added alongside the normal basic attack damage
quotes: dealing {{as|120% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to the target and nearby enemies

unsettled.question: Does casting Duskbringer while already standing on a Dusk Trail (from a prior Q) still gain the movement/AD buff refresh, and can Nocturne chain-cast Q for repeated buff uptime within the 8s cooldown, given the sources only clarify the damage does not scale?
options: Trail buff refreshes/reapplies on each Q cast regardless of prior trail state, giving near-permanent bonus AD/MS at max rank (8s cooldown vs 5s trail)
Only the initial cast that creates a trail (e.g., off self-move or after champion hit) grants the buff; re-casting doesn't meaningfully change uptime
quotes: It is observed from seasons ago that this is intentionally hard-coded into the ability to avoid the projectile increasing its own damage. This feature is somewhat deprecated as it also limits chain-casting ''Duskbringer''.

unsettled.question: Is the bin's Paranoia (NocturneParanoia) or Paranoia2 (NocturneParanoia2, cooldown 150/125/100) the live row used in-game, since both share identical damage but differ in cooldown from each other and from the wiki's stated cooldown (140/115/90)?
options: NocturneParanoia2 is live (cooldown 150/125/100, differs from wiki)
quotes: cooldown     = {{tt|{{ap|140 to 90}}|Starts after recast times out or is used}}

unsettled.question: During Paranoia's recast dash, can Nocturne's other abilities (Q/E/W) and basic attacks land normally without interruption, and does the dash itself introduce any delay that eats into the 15s fight window before the R damage lands?
options: Dash is near-instant (1800 dash speed) so R recast damage effectively lands almost immediately when target is in range, other actions can be freely interleaved
Dash travel time is meaningfully long at typical engagement ranges, delaying R's damage and briefly blocking attack windows
quotes: '''Nocturne''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]], [[summoner spell|summoner spells]]

proposal: Open with Q (Duskbringer) on the dummy to deal upfront physical damage and, if it counts as hitting an enemy champion equivalent, establish the Dusk Trail bonus AD/MS buff.
Immediately follow with E (Unspeakable Horror) to attach the tether and start its DoT ticking every 0.5s over 2s.
Weave in basic attacks throughout, since they reduce Umbra Blades' (P) cooldown (3s per hit vs a champion-tagged target) and each empowered attack deals bonus physical damage that can crit.

Use W (Shroud of Darkness) primarily for the passive bonus attack speed uptime; its active spell shield has no target to block in a dummy fight, so cast it early only if the sim credits the passive AS regardless, or refrain if it consumes a GCD-equivalent without benefit.

Cast R (Paranoia) as early as possible against the dummy (treated as an enemy champion) and recast promptly to trigger the dash-arrival physical damage, weaving in other abilities/attacks during the dash.

Re-cast Q on cooldown (every 8s) and E on cooldown (~11-15s depending on rank) for their damage, continuing to auto-attack between casts to maximize Umbra Blades procs and uptime of Q's bonus AD trail.
questions: Does the dummy fight simulator apply Umbra Blades' passive purely on its internal cooldown timer, or does it require a minimum number of qualifying basic attacks to fire, and how should its cooldown reduction from attacks be modeled turn-by-turn?

In a single-target dummy fight, does Paranoia's recast (R) require the target to be within TrackDistance/target range from the moment of initial cast, and is the dash-arrival damage delayed by travel time or effectively instant given the short engagement range assumed?

Should W be cast for its passive attack speed value even though its active spell-shield component is never useful against a passive dummy, or does the simulator only grant W's passive bonus once the ability is leveled without needing to actively recast it?
Does chain-casting Duskbringer (Q) every 8s meaningfully refresh/extend the Dusk Trail bonus AD/MS buff uptime, or is uptime capped at roughly 5s per cast with a 3s gap where the buff lapses?
